how: Drone racing events have been held in Tokyo (an FAI-sanctioned race at Tokyo Big Sight in 2019) and DJI opened an indoor flying arena in 2017; regular leagues mainly race in neighbouring Chiba.
Mount Mitake in Ome, western Tokyo prefecture, is a bouldering area described as the nearest to the city; sport and trad areas such as Ogawayama and Mizugaki are 3+ hours away.
Urban farm experiences and rental community garden plots operate in Tokyo, e.g. the Yakumo no Hatake community garden in Meguro and rooftop and hydroponic workshops.
Pick-your-own mushroom gardens exist in the Tama area (Uchinuma Kinoko-en), but guided wild mushroom foraging was not found.
Tokyo Dragon Boat Tournament is held at Odaiba Kaihin Park with full support for first-time teams; the Sea Forest Waterway is also used for dragon boating.
venue: Tokyo Dragon Boat Tournament (Odaiba Kaihin Park)

how: Cable wakeboarding has been staged in Tokyo (a Cable Wakeboard World Cup at Odaiba under Rainbow Bridge); regular wakeboarding parks are mostly in surrounding prefectures.
Recreational drone flying is legal in Japan under MLIT rules (registration for drones over 100 g, restrictions in dense areas), with riverside and park spots used around Tokyo.
English-language acting workshops (a one-day intensive by UPS) and weekly improv classes at Tokyo Comedy School near Yoyogi-Koen are available.
Argentine tango lessons run at studios such as Doble A in Sengoku, taught by former Buenos Aires Tango Pista champions.
The Vivekananda Cultural Centre at the Embassy of India in Tokyo has held workshops and lessons in Indian classical dance including Bharatanatyam.
venue: Vivekananda Cultural Centre, Embassy of India

how: The Vivekananda Cultural Centre at the Embassy of India in Tokyo has run tabla workshops and lessons.

how: Art Flow Tokyo is a pole and aerial dance studio with classes from beginner to advanced, and Rei Dance Collection also runs pole classes in Shibuya.
Tokyo VIBESRECORDS in Setagaya offers DJ lessons with a professional instructor, including a short beginner session with hands-on practice.
Choirs such as Tokyo Musik Kreis and the Bach Akademie Meiji Gakuin Tokyo chorus draw singers from across the city.
Over 50 Indonesian gamelan groups exist in Japan, with Indonesian performing arts shown in Tokyo most weekends.
Guitar lessons in English and Japanese are offered in Tokyo, e.g. American Guitar Academy (Roppongi, Sendagi) and JiLL Music School (Shibuya, Ikebukuro).
The Sogetsu Foundation at its Tokyo headquarters offers hands-on ikebana lessons with a master instructor in English or Japanese, and many English-speaking instructors teach private classes.
Short hands-on kintsugi workshops with English-speaking instructors run in Asakusa (Kuge Crafts Studio) and other Tokyo studios.
Tokyo booking platforms list glass-bead making experiences alongside Edo kiriko glass cutting.
Custom perfume blending sessions run in Monzen-Nakacho, Asakusa, Omotesando and Harajuku, with a certified blend designer in some.
